answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. An agent must burn a deposit to claim one work slot, like paying for a berth in a harbor: one berth, one ship. It posts a liveness signal hourly, and a cedar receipt proves the deposit backs only this slot. Forging 100 identities burns 100 deposits of 50 coins, 5000 coins, while one slot earns 30 coins, so the attack loses 4970 coins. An honest agent burns one deposit and keeps its reward undiluted.
